These six small educational games star Freddy the Frog. Each uses simple controls to ensure that children can play without difficulty from the software.

Using forward, back, left and right keys Freddy must get to various important buildings as depicted on the screen. In Adding he is presented with a network of lily pads, some of which contain numbers or mathematical symbols. Land on these in the correct order to produce a correct sum. In the Toyshop, first identify toys from their names, then choose a toy at a specified price, and then combine goods to meet a specified price limit.

Electricity allows you to learn about circuits - by working out whether an existing layout will work, and modifying it so that it will. The next game involves telling the time, so as to get the prince his key. Funtext teaches information searching using a Ceefax-type environment.

465851.overview: This is a word processor program that teaches children to write and print words, sentences and stories, with help from Big Bird, Cookie Monster, Oscar the Grouch and Elmo.

467398.overview:
Battle Tetris is a Tetris game featuring single-player, two-player, and versus-CPU modes with five difficulty levels. Players arrange tetrominoes into horizontal lines, which vanish to clear space and award points.

Multiplayer is built around a central mechanical piston that separates the two play fields.  This central gauge acts as a tug-of-war meter; when one player clears multiple lines at once, they launch an "attack" that physically pushes this piston toward the opponent. This action forces "garbage" rows—incomplete lines of blocks—up from the bottom of the opponent’s well, rapidly shrinking their available workspace.

469342.overview:
This page contains not a popular browser at all, but an exclusive Chinese (and, it seems, PRC, not Taiwanese!) two-dimensional platformer. The plot is extremely conventional: an anthropomorphic fox - a government agent, for whom we have to play, pursues another anthropomorphic fox, an international criminal - while the chase will stretch over seven levels, inhabited by various creatures hostile to our hero, which will have to be killed.

It may seem surprising, but Fire Fox is a very simple game, even for a platformer in general, and even more so for a representative of this subgenre originally from East Asia. It cannot be called completely elementary, since there is a risk of death here - but still it is clearly aimed at children and (or) people who do not like "fast" arcades. The perspective of the view, of course, is a side view. In the upper left corner of the screen, next to the portrait of the protagonist, the number of "lives" he has is displayed, and a little below, in the form of grayish dots, the health reserve within each of them, numbering several points. The fox can jump ("space"), and uses an infinite set of sticks ("Ctrl") as a weapon. You can improve your health with the help of bonuses in the form of various food products (sausages, hamburgers, and so on), which are not found on every corner, but still not very rare. At each level, you can collect diamonds, which are kept in the upper right corner - unfortunately, it is unknown whether finding each such object is a prerequisite for completing the level, but in any case, it will be difficult to miss them. To move on to the next stage, you need to take a bonus in the form of a conditional "medal" and, in fact, get to the finish point.

There are not very many opponents - both in number and in varieties, and they do not represent anything really interesting. At the first level, for example, you will have to fight with upright hedgehogs, moving back and forth along tiny predetermined trajectories and by default not showing aggression towards the protagonist, and large Viking jugglers standing still and inclined to chase the hero a little when approaching them; However, both are killed easily and quickly. Respawn in case of death occurs at the start of the stage without saving achievements. The mechanics of jumping are very simple: in fact, there are not even the usual "platforms" for the genre, but only narrow abysses (to successfully overcome which it is most often enough to stand on the edge of a cliff) and ledges. With the latter, the situation is a little more complicated: when jumping, the character clings to the surface with his hands, and in order to climb to the tier above, you need to simultaneously press the jump and move buttons in a certain direction. At the same time, occasionally abysses, for which the starting point has to be calculated, still occur.

470407.overview:
FE's only 1-on-1 fighter is also one of the most rare of their games. Surprisingly, considering that it was released closely after their big success with Yahwa and got a lot of good press.

As the title vaguely suggests, the game takes place around the ruins of a lost civilization in the Taklamakan Desert in central Asia. 12 pre-rendered combatants, training and team battle modes make this a more wholesome package than most contemporary Korean fighting games. According to the press release, the combo system allows for up to 12 connected hits.

470409.overview:
The plot is simple. After sizzling global nuclear conflict with the human genome everything finally went somehow "wrong". People have become mutants, resulting in a long time they have to be in the biological condition of the dragons. While these dragons in the game are mostly the most that neither is a common dinosaurs (reptilian theory supporters rejoice!). In general, outside of the ring all of these fighters for ecological reasons unknown to us are forced to eke out their miserable existence in the form of mindless dinosaurs, and only in brief moments of uncompromising struggle, they regain the ability to be a short time people.

Fighters only eight, and they are all colorful, because, as has been said, people "a little bit" mutated. The first fighter named Attila, politically correct to put it - a hybrid of human and bird dog. Next comes Chios - man-cat, is nothing unusual: only the claws on his hands and a mustache on his face. There is still Pliny - very muscular fighter. Pliny escaped severe mutations, but his hair is steel blue. Then comes Rauric - a soldier dressed in armor. With Rauric in terms of genetics is also all right, but one of the brushes (left) in his amputated and replaced it attached to a hand prosthesis - a sharp sword. Of course, in any fighting game must be present, and women fighters. In this game, they already two, they are both muscular, combative and, of course, frivolously dressed (just useless clothes hamper movement in combat). The first female fighter - Agariste, her big ears and the back has a long tail, which tells us about the genetic closeness to the family cat. Second - Arian, in her hand a heavy rectangular boomerang but sharp ears no abnormalities in the genome of her, apparently not. The colorful fighters questionnaire provides information about their character and personal preferences. There are still two fighters: Tyrell and Stadiatis, but somehow for their personal profiles developers were not provided.

470463.overview: Fray Luis is a DOS game released in 1998 by Hollywood Publishing and developed by Narcogames. The game is an action platformer set in a supernatural world, where players assume the role of Fray Luis, a powerful friar tasked with preventing the end of the world. The game features six stages, each with unique objectives, obstacles, and enemies, including monks, demons, and bewitched animals. Players must navigate through these challenges to defeat the abbot and save the world.

470719.overview:
An extremely little-known game, the latest creation of the Spanish company Goldy Games, released not in Spanish, but in English.

Turbo Flashy Cars is basically two games in one. The first is a puzzle in which you need to assemble an image of a hand-drawn car on some interesting background from virtual "pieces". The second is a cartoon race with a top view, where you drive a funny "retro" car and have to go through a relatively difficult track in conditions of limited fuel and the need to avoid a number of "deadly" obstacles for our car (such as pits) or not fatal, but no less dangerous (for example, there are several types of dangers at once that can change the direction of the car by 180 degrees, which is fraught with big problems). In this mode, the game is not very difficult, but it cannot be called simple either.

All this is presented in not really beautiful, but bright and quite sufficient for such a game EGA palette. In general, nothing special, but the combination of a race and a puzzle in one game is still an interesting solution.

474245.overview:
Football Masters ’98 is a football (soccer) management simulation developed by ESP Software, placing the player in control of every aspect of running a professional club across a competitive season. Rather than controlling players directly on the pitch, the game focuses on the strategic and administrative side of the sport, including selecting squads, organizing training, negotiating contracts, and managing finances. Players guide their chosen team through domestic leagues and cup competitions, making decisions that influence performance both on and off the field.

Matches are presented through a simplified visual interface that tracks the flow of play, allowing the manager to pause and adjust tactics, formations, and player positioning in real time. The game offers depth and flexibility with features such as scouting, youth development, sponsorship deals, stadium management, and detailed transfer negotiations.

474347.overview:
A bunch of prisoners have escaped from a prison bus and you, as the Sheriff's deputy, must take them out. Unfortunately, they have had help in escaping, and have been supplied with guns. 

Blood Bath at Red Falls is a shooting gallery game where the enemies are digitized actors who pop up from behind cover on the different screens. You can shoot for other items including ammo, a better gun, extra hits and lives. Be careful not to shoot innocent hostages who might get in the way. There are three difficulty levels: Easy, Bring it on, and Bad Ass.

475169.overview:
DOS Clone of the Catman/Pitman GameBoy game.
Apparently made as a programming exercise or final master project of some kind.
475169.developer: Alex Sanchez, Jordi Alborch, Jordi Muñoz

477345.overview:
Overview and Developer
Violent Myth was released in 1994 as a 3.5-inch IBM PC/AT DOS disk by the Taiwanese developer Dysin Information / Dysing Information

Gaming History. The game was relatively obscure and is primarily remembered as a simple fighting game with mythological characters. Despite its limited recognition, it is preserved in software archives running on MS-DOS systems.

Gameplay
The game is a single-player, shared-screen fighting game, where players engage in one-on-one combat using unusual participants drawn from the Chinese pantheon of heroes and mythological figures. Each character has unique fighting abilities and animations, though the game mechanics are noted for their simplicity. Combat occurs on a fixed screen rather than scrolling environments, emphasizing direct confrontations between the chosen characters.

Visuals and Style
The graphics are characteristic of early 1990s DOS games, employing pixel art with modest animations. While not highly advanced, the game attempts to represent its mythological figures faithfully within the technical limitations of the platform.

Access and Legacy
Although Violent Myth did not achieve mainstream success, it is now archived for historical and preservation purposes. The game can be accessed and played via the Internet Archive, allowing users to stream it directly in-browser using emulation.

Unique Features
Characters drawn from Chinese mythology, making the fighter roster distinct from more conventional fighting games of the era. Simple, accessible fighting mechanics with a shared-screen interface.
Developed by a lesser-known Taiwanese company, which makes it a notable example of early PC fighting games outside the more prominent Japanese or Western developers.

481784.overview:
Flame Dragon Knights: The Seal of the Evil God is a classic Taiwanese tactical RPG released for MS-DOS in 1994. The story follows prince 雷特 (Let) of Rotidia Kingdom, who survives a coup and embarks on a journey to reclaim his homeland and seal the great evil god. Grid-based turn-based tactical battles, unit class promotion, multiple story endings, and full-screen battle animations. This is the first entry in the Flame Dragon Knights series.
汉堂国际 1994 年出品 DOS 回合战棋 SRPG，炎龙骑士团系列首作。罗特帝亚王国发生政变，王子雷特踏上复国旅程，对抗魔族邪神。网格回合战斗、自动转职、多结局。早期软盘版发行，无隐藏商店，角色等级上限 20 级。

481962.overview:
Flame Dragon Knights 2: Legend of the Golden Castle is the second and most famous entry in the Flame Dragon tactical RPG series. The story follows 索尔 (Sol), adopted son of King Let, and the amnesiac girl Yuni. Features 30+ playable characters, secret shops, hidden character recruitments, optional secret final stages, branching hidden class promotions, and enhanced full-screen combat animations.
1995 年汉堂经典国产战棋，炎龙系列巅峰。前作主角雷特的养子索尔，偶遇失忆少女悠妮，前往寻找古代浮空黄金城。大量隐藏要素：秘密商店、隐藏转职、隐藏关卡、多结局。角色多达 32 人，职业分支丰富，是华语 DOS 战棋标杆作品。

481972.overview:
Flame Dragon Plus: Marks of Wind is the final entry of the classic Taiwanese tactical RPG series Flame Dragon Knights. The story takes place after the events of Flame Dragon Knights 2. The protagonist Landis, a half-god half-human youth, embarks on an adventure to search for his missing mother, crossing paths with the former hero 索尔 (Soar). It retains the turn-based grid battle system of the previous work, greatly enhances special skill animations, includes multiple secret stages and two endings. It was the series' first CD-ROM release on DOS.
炎龙骑士团系列收官之作，故事承接《黄金城之谜》。主角兰迪斯是人与女神混血的青年，踏上寻找母亲的旅途，并与前作主角索尔相遇。延续系列网格回合战棋，大幅强化必杀特技动画，内含多隐藏关卡、双结局。是系列首款 CD-ROM 介质版本。

482716.overview: Play the chosen-trump variant of the Czech card game mariáš against two computer-controlled opponents. Select a contract, manage trumps and try to win the necessary tricks. Calling flek raises the stake, making assessment of your hand part of the strategy.

482722.overview: Drive a school bus around a small town, collect children from the stops and bring them to school. Difficulty settings change where passengers appear and introduce time pressure or blocked roads. Choosing a useful route becomes part of the challenge as the town grows less straightforward to navigate. The Fisher-Price characters frame an accessible game about memory and orientation.

482733.overview: Fire and Ice: The Christmas Demo is a DOS demo giving Cool Coyote festive levels of his own. Wearing a Santa outfit, he collects scattered presents and food while avoiding hostile wildlife on the way to Christmas dinner.
